item.title: Worktree mode: sprint archive entries lost after worktree cleanup
item.intent: Every completed sprint in worktree mode must appear in the main repo's sprints.jsonl exactly as in stash mode.
steps: In _handle_sprint_success, locate the worktree cleanup block (~line 2514)
Before calling _cleanup_worktree, capture the last line appended to the worktree's sprints.jsonl (the just-written archive entry)
After _cleanup_worktree restores ARCHIVE_DIR to the main repo path, append the captured entry to the main repo's sprints.jsonl
Create ARCHIVE_DIR if it doesn't exist (mkdir -p)
Run shellcheck and verify no new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: After a sprint completes in worktree mode, the entry appears in backlog/archive/sprints.jsonl in the main repo
aishore metrics and aishore backlog history show the sprint in worktree mode
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
